capabilities: Split notes into slides by horizontal rules or headings
Continue long sections onto extra slides at paragraph boundaries
Scale overflowing content to fit the screen
Render wikilinks, embeds, callouts, math, Mermaid and code as in reading view
Draw with laser pointer, pen and highlighter
extras: Install via BRAT with zhangmin510/obsidian-podium or by copying release assets into .obsidian/plugins/podium/. Per-note frontmatter overrides: slide-split (auto, hr, heading, h1, h2, h3) and slide-max-lines.
problem: Turning a note into slides normally needs manual separator syntax and hand-tuned splitting so that long sections and wide tables still fit the screen.
summary: Presents any Markdown note as fullscreen slides, splitting by rules or headings and scaling content to fit the screen.
